svg.title: How the final demo's ER step is scored
svg.desc: A flow diagram. One cell on the inspection conveyor feeds three rows. Row 1, tag 1: a lidar scan and the GP2 detector give an inspection report with a defect type. Row 2, tag 2: a camera image goes to the ER model; tag 3: its JSON answer goes through a schema check, and a rejected answer goes to a dashed box: left out, counted. Row 3, tag 4: ground truth from a practice run log (log_cell_info:=true). All three rows lead to tag 5: compare on the same cells, per defect type, true positives, false positives and false negatives. That leads to tag 6: precision and recall per type, latency and cost per call, and the number of cells used.
